cards.target: Bydd y siop yn cau am chwech o'r gloch.
cards.english: The shop will close at six o'clock.
cards.existing: `Bydd` = 'will be' (3rd person), future of `bod`. `Bydd hi'n bwrw glaw` (It'll rain). Most common future form in conversation.

cards.target: Byddwn ni'n cael swper am saith o'r gloch.
cards.english: We will have dinner at seven o'clock.
cards.existing: Conditional forms (`byddwn`, `byddai`, `baswn`) = 'would'. `Byddwn i'n hoffi` (I would like). For 'if' clauses use `petai` or `pe bai`.

cards.target: Byddwn ni'n cael cyfarfod am ddau o'r gloch.
cards.english: We will have a meeting at two o'clock.
cards.existing: Two conditional families: `bydd-` (modern, standard) and `bas-` (also modern, very common). Both translate as 'would (be)' + a following verb-noun.

cards.target: Bydd y trên yn gadael am hanner awr wedi tri.
cards.english: The train will leave at half past three.

cards.target: Bydd hi'n ysgrifennu llythyr at ei mam-gu.
cards.english: She will write a letter to her grandmother.

cards.target: Bydd hi'n dechrau ei swydd newydd ym mis Medi.
cards.english: She will start her new job in September.
cards.existing: Full future of `bod`: `byddaf i, byddi di, bydd e/hi, byddwn ni, byddwch chi, byddan nhw`. Often written and spoken with the pronoun.

cards.target: Bydd y cyngerdd yn dechrau am hanner awr wedi saith.
cards.english: The concert will start at half past seven.

cards.target: Pe bai'r trên ar amser, fyddwn i ddim yn hwyr.
cards.english: If the train were on time, I wouldn't be late.

cards.target: Pe bai ddim mor bell, byddwn i'n cerdded yno.
cards.english: If it weren't so far, I'd walk there.

cards.target: Pe bai trafnidiaeth gyhoeddus am ddim, byddai pawb yn ei defnyddio.
cards.english: If public transport were free, everyone would use it.
cards.existing: Two conditional families: `bydd-` (modern, standard) and `bas-` (also modern, very common). Both translate as 'would (be)' + a following verb-noun.

cards.target: Os bydd e'n darllen y map, fyddwn ni ddim yn mynd ar goll.
cards.english: If he reads the map, we won't get lost.

cards.target: Croeso i Gymru, gobeithio byddwch chi'n mwynhau!
cards.english: Welcome to Wales, I hope you'll enjoy it!

cards.target: Pe gallwn i goginio fel hi, byddwn i'n agor bwyty.
cards.english: If I could cook like her, I'd open a restaurant.

cards.target: Sefwch ar eich traed!
cards.english: Stand up!

cards.target: Ewch i fyny'r bryn.
cards.english: Go up the hill.

cards.target: Mae ei gywyddau'n enwog.
cards.english: His cywyddau are famous.

cards.target: Mae gen i anifail anwes.
cards.english: I have a pet.

cards.target: Mae ganddo fo gi du.
cards.english: He has a black dog.

cards.target: Addawodd hi na fyddai'n hwyr.
cards.english: She promised she wouldn't be late.

cards.target: Mae gennym ni bedwar o blant.
cards.english: We have four children.

cards.target: Mae gen i alergedd i laeth.
cards.english: I have a milk allergy.

cards.target: Paid â phoeni am wneud camgymeriadau.
cards.english: Don't worry about making mistakes.

cards.target: Paid â brysio, cymer dy amser.
cards.english: Don't rush, take your time.

cards.target: Mae'r ffilm hon cystal â'r llyfr.
cards.english: This film is as good as the book.

cards.target: Paid â chymharu dy hun ag eraill.
cards.english: Don't compare yourself to others.

cards.target: Mae'r parc yn agos at y llyfrgell.
cards.english: The park is near the library.

cards.target: Bydd hi'n bwrw glaw yn hwyrach heno.
cards.english: It will rain later this evening.

cards.target: Stopiwch y car wrth yr arwydd coch!
cards.english: Stop the car at the red sign!

cards.target: Byddwn ni'n archebu bwyd o'r bwyty newydd.
cards.english: We will order food from the new restaurant.

cards.target: Dychwelodd yr alarch du i'r llyn eleni.
cards.english: The black swan returned to the lake this year.

cards.target: Dewch i weld y machlud dros y môr!
cards.english: Come and see the sunset over the sea!

cards.target: Rydw i'n malu'r pupur du dros y salad.
cards.english: I grind the black pepper over the salad.

cards.target: Byddan nhw'n cyrraedd y maes awyr bore yfory.
cards.english: They will arrive at the airport tomorrow morning.

cards.target: Mae'r robin goch yn ymweld â'r ardd bob bore.
cards.english: The robin comes to the garden every morning.

cards.target: Bydd y theatr newydd yn agor y flwyddyn nesaf.
cards.english: The new theatre will open next year.

cards.target: Os awn ni nawr, byddwn ni'n cyrraedd mewn pryd.
cards.english: If we leave now, we'll arrive on time.

cards.target: Paid â bod yn rhy galed arnat ti dy hun.
cards.english: Don't be too hard on yourself.

cards.target: Os bydd y siop ar agor, bydda i'n prynu llaeth.
cards.english: If the shop is open, I'll buy some milk.

cards.target: Cadwa dy ffocws ar y nod.
cards.english: Keep your focus on the goal.

cards.target: Mae gen i radd mewn Cymraeg.
cards.english: I have a degree in Welsh.

cards.target: Mae'r calligraffeg yn gelfyddyd ysgrifennu cain.
cards.english: Calligraphy is the art of beautiful writing.

cards.target: Mae'r ardd mor brydferth â llun.
cards.english: The garden is as beautiful as a painting.

cards.target: Mae heddwch mewnol yn anodd ei ganfod.
cards.english: Inner peace is hard to find.

cards.target: Mae Parc Cenedlaethol Eryri yn lle arbennig.
cards.english: Snowdonia National Park is a special place.

cards.target: Mae'r blagur pinc yn arwydd o'r gwanwyn.
cards.english: The pink buds are a sign of spring.

cards.target: Paid â rhoi'r ffidl yn y to.
cards.english: Don't throw in the towel.

cards.target: Mae angen diwygio'r system addysg yn llwyr.
cards.english: The education system needs to be completely reformed.

cards.target: Mae'r clogyn gwyrdd yn amddiffyn rhag y glaw.
cards.english: The green cloak protects from the rain.

cards.target: Mae'r sêr teledu yn cerdded y carped coch.
cards.english: The TV stars walk the red carpet.

cards.target: Mae'r llosgi eira yn disgyn fel blanced wen.
cards.english: The snowfall descends like a white blanket.

cards.target: Gwelais i chwe barcud coch uwchben y dyffryn.
cards.english: I saw six red kites above the valley.

cards.target: Mae'r prisem yn hollti'r golau gwyn yn sbectrwm.
cards.english: The prism splits white light into a spectrum.

cards.target: Byddwn ni'n aros mewn gwesty ger yr arfordir.
cards.english: We will stay at a hotel near the coast.

cards.target: Os bwcia i'n gynnar, bydd y tocynnau'n rhatach.
cards.english: If I book early, the tickets will be cheaper.

cards.target: Mae'r glaswellt gwyrdd yn ymestyn hyd at y gorwel.
cards.english: The green grass stretches to the horizon.

cards.target: Mae'r bwyd cartref yn flasusach na bwyd y caffi.
cards.english: Home food is tastier than café food.

cards.target: Gwelodd Heledd y barcud coch yn hedfan dros y cwm.
cards.english: Heledd saw the red kite flying over the valley.

cards.target: Bydd hi'n bwrw eira yn y mynyddoedd erbyn nos yfory.
cards.english: It will be snowing in the mountains by tomorrow night.

cards.target: Os bydd hi'n darllen y llyfr yma, bydd hi'n ei fwynhau.
cards.english: If she reads this book, she'll enjoy it.

cards.target: Os dalwn ni'r trên cynnar, byddwn ni yno erbyn canol dydd.
cards.english: If we catch the early train, we'll be there by noon.

cards.target: Cymerwch ofal wrth yrru.
cards.english: Take care while driving.

cards.target: Peidiwch â bwydo'r merlod gwyllt!
cards.english: Don't feed the wild ponies!

cards.target: Paid â digalonni oherwydd rhwystrau.
cards.english: Don't be discouraged by setbacks.

cards.target: Mae'r hwyaid ar y pwll.
cards.english: The ducks are on the pond.

cards.target: Edrychwn ymlaen at eich ateb.
cards.english: We look forward to your reply.
cards.existing: Direct object of a verb often uses the possessive: `fy ngweld i` (to see me – literally 'my seeing me'). Welsh objects can ride along as possessives in verb-noun phrases.

cards.target: Dewi Sant yw nawddsant Cymru.
cards.english: St David is the patron saint of Wales.

cards.target: Dwynwen yw nawddsant cariadon Cymru.
cards.english: Dwynwen is the Welsh patron saint of lovers.

cards.target: Mae'r coriander yn addurno'r pryd gorffenedig.
cards.english: Coriander decorates the finished dish.
cards.existing: `Pryd` = 'when' in questions: `Pryd wyt ti'n dod?` (When are you coming?). Two different words for two roles.

cards.target: Yn hytrach na chwyno, gwnewch rywbeth.
cards.english: Rather than complaining, do something.

cards.target: Mae'r dyddiadur yn cofnodi apwyntiadau pwysig.
cards.english: The diary records important appointments.

cards.target: Yfon ni goffi yn y caffi.
cards.english: We drank coffee at the café.

cards.target: Mae'r Noson Lawen yn ddigwyddiad poblogaidd.
cards.english: The Noson Lawen is a popular event.

cards.target: Mae'r ffrwythwr yn arddangos afalau a gellyg.
cards.english: The fruiterer displays apples and pears.

cards.target: Mae'r pregethwr yn traddodi'r bregeth yn angerddol.
cards.english: The preacher delivers the sermon passionately.

cards.target: Mae'r heddwas yn patrolio strydoedd y dref.
cards.english: The policeman patrols the town streets.

cards.target: Mae'r panther du yn sleifio drwy'r jyngl.
cards.english: The black panther slinks through the jungle.

cards.target: Mae'r masiwn yn codi wal gerrig gadarn.
cards.english: The mason builds a sturdy stone wall.

cards.target: Mae'r Mabinogi yn gasgliad o chwedlau Cymreig.
cards.english: The Mabinogi is a collection of Welsh tales.

cards.target: Mae'r obsidian yn wydr folcanig du a miniog.
cards.english: Obsidian is sharp black volcanic glass.

cards.target: Mae'r groser yn stocio nwyddau o bob cwr.
cards.english: The grocer stocks goods from everywhere.

cards.target: Mae'r twll du yn llyncu golau a mater.
cards.english: The black hole swallows light and matter.

cards.target: Mae'r barcud coch yn cylchu uwchben y dyffryn.
cards.english: The red kite circles above the valley.

cards.target: Mae'r golchwr ffenestri yn dringo'r ysgol yn ofalus.
cards.english: The window cleaner climbs the ladder carefully.

cards.target: Mae'r saethwr yn anelu at y targed pellaf.
cards.english: The archer aims at the farthest target.

cards.target: Rhaid i Siân roi araith yn y seremoni.
cards.english: Siân must give a speech at the ceremony.

cards.target: Mae Pobol y Cwm yn opera sebon Gymraeg.
cards.english: Pobol y Cwm is a Welsh soap opera.

cards.target: Siaredir Cymraeg mewn llawer o rannau o Gymru.
cards.english: Welsh is spoken in many parts of Wales.

cards.target: Mae'r gnocell y coed yn taro'r rhisgl yn rhythmig.
cards.english: The woodpecker strikes the bark rhythmically.

cards.target: Mae twristiaeth yn creu swyddi yng nghefn gwlad Cymru.
cards.english: Tourism creates jobs in rural Wales.

cards.target: Mae'r tancer yn cludo olew ar hyd y draffordd.
cards.english: The tanker transports oil along the motorway.

cards.target: Mae'r penrhyn yn ymestyn i'r môr fel bys enfawr.
cards.english: The peninsula extends into the sea like an enormous finger.

cards.target: Mae clybiau ieuenctid yn darparu mannau diogel i bobl ifanc.
cards.english: Youth clubs provide safe spaces for teenagers.

cards.target: Mae'r hanesydd yn dadansoddi dogfennau o'r unfed ganrif ar bymtheg.
cards.english: The historian analyses documents from the sixteenth century.
